case.description: A face-swapped meme traced from an Instagram post to copies on other accounts. Shows the spread map, versions and leads. Source: https://www.instagram.com/p/DMzd8nbIqAo/
case.title: Demo 2 · Face-swap meme found through an Instagram post

verdict.label: likely_fake
verdict.headline: Likely fake
verdict.engine_note: Decided by Hive (commercial detector). Local detectors give the second opinion.
reasons: Hive's AI-image detector found no sign of an AI image generator (0% AI-generated).
Hive's deepfake check flags a face swap (84%).
Second opinion disagrees — our local detectors say Likely real (16% likely fake).
caveats: A verdict says how the picture was made, not who made it or whether the event it shows happened.
verdict.reliability: Hive was tested here on 87 held-out images from recent AI generators and real photo sources: right 99% of the time — real photos called real 100%, fakes caught 97%.
verdict.summary: This is probably fake (Face swap / edited photo) — 84% likely fake.
